name: eige-api
description: EIGE v10 Intelligence Engine — Website Technology Stack Analysis API. Detects 100+ technologies, classifies ecosystem archetypes, generates knowledge-base-powered intelligence reports, and self-improves through a quality-gated adaptive learning system.

scripts.seed:all: node scripts/seed_patterns.js && node scripts/seed_clusters.js && node scripts/seed_intelligence.js
scripts.db:migrate: echo 'Run SQL migrations manually in Supabase SQL Editor — see sql/ directory'
scripts.health: curl -s http://localhost:8080/health | node -e "process.stdin.resume(); let d=''; process.stdin.on('data', c => d+=c); process.stdin.on('end', () => console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(d), null, 2)))"
scripts.status: curl -s http://localhost:8080/status | node -e "process.stdin.resume(); let d=''; process.stdin.on('data', c => d+=c); process.stdin.on('end', () => console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(d), null, 2)))"
